These public test files are from the MIT-licensed reference repository
https://github.com/asmw/andOTP-decrypt/tree/master/testdata. The fixture
password is `123456`. They contain only synthetic test accounts.

- `old.aes`: the legacy encryption sample.
- `current.aes`: the newer encryption sample.
- `accounts.aes`: a newer sample with issuer fields.

The upstream license is included in this directory.
